verses.en: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.sm: Tavita, ma ua tuu tulu‘i lona ola, ona faia lea e ia o Solomona lona atalii ma tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.sm: Ua faapotopotoina e ia o alii uma o Isaraelu, atoa ma le au faitaulaga, ma sa Levi.

verses.en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
verses.sm: Ua faitauina sa Levi, e afua mai i e ua tolu sefulu o latou tausaga, ma e ua matutua ai; o le faitau aofai o tagata, e tolu sefulu o afe ma afe e valu.

verses.en: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officers and judges:
verses.sm: Sa tofia e pwe ile galuega o le fale o le ALII e lua sefulu ma le fa o afe o i latou, ma le ono o afe e fai ma faipule ma faamasino;

verses.en: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
verses.sm: Ole fa o afe e fai ma leoleo faitotoa, ma le fa o afe ua vivii atu i le ALII, i laau pese na ou faia e vivii ai.

verses.en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.sm: Ua vaevaeina i latou e Tavita i vasega i atalii o Levi, o Keresona, o Koato, ma Merari.

verses.en: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
verses.sm: O sa Keresoná; o Latana, ma Semi.

verses.en: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.sm: O atalii o Latana; o le alii sili o Ieielu, i le ma Setama, ma loelu, e toatolu ia.

verses.en: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
verses.sm: O ataw o Semi; o Salome, ma Asielu, ma Arana, e toatolu ia. O matai sili ia o Latana.

verses.en: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.sm: O atalii o Semi, o lata, o Sesa, ma luso, ma Peria. O ataw o Semi, e toafa ia.

verses.en: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.
verses.sm: O lata o le alii sili ia, ma Sesa o le aupito ane i ai; a o luso, ma Pena ua le toatele ni a laua fanau; o le mea lea sa faitauina faatasi ai i laua ma le aiga o laua tama.

verses.en: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.sm: O atalii o Koato; o Amaramo, o Isara, o Heperona, ma Usialu, e toafa ia.

verses.en: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
verses.sm: O atalii o Amaramo; o Arona, ma Mose; ua vavaeeseina Arona na te faapaiaina mea e sili ona paia, o ia ma ona atalii e faavavau, e faamu ai mea manogi i luma o le ALII, e auauna ia te ia, ma faamanuia atu i le nuu i lona suafa e faavavau.

verses.en: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
verses.sm: A o Mose le tagata o le Atua, sa taʻua ona atalii i le itu aiga o Levi.

verses.en: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
verses.sm: O atalii o Mose; o Keresoma, ma Elisara.

verses.en: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
verses.sm: O atalii o Keresoma; o Sepuelu o le sili ia.

verses.en: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.sm: O le atalii o Elisara; o Reapea o le sili ia. Sa leai se tasi atalii ia Elisara; a o atalii o Reapea ua matuá toatele i latou.

verses.en: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
verses.sm: O atalii o Isara; o Salome, o le sili ia.

verses.en: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.sm: O atalii o Heperona; o Ieria o le sili, o Amaria le toalua, o laaseelu le toatolu, ma Ikamamo le toafa.

verses.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.
verses.sm: O atalii o Usialu; o Mika le sili, ma Isea le toalua.

verses.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
verses.sm: O atalii o Merari; o Maali, ma Musi. O atalii o Maali; o Eleasaro, ma Kiso.

verses.en: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
verses.sm: Ua oti Eleasaro, a ua leai ni ona atalii, na o afafine; ua fai ava foi ia te i latou o atalii o Kiso, o latou lava aiga.

verses.en: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.sm: O atalii o Musi; o Maali, ma Eteru, ma Ieremota, e toatolu.

verses.en: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.
verses.sm: O atalii ia o Levi i le aiga o latou tama, o matai sili e faatatau i le faitauina o i latou i le faitau aofai o latou igoa, e na faia le galuega e auauna ai i le fale o le ALII, e afua mai i e ua luafulu o latou tausaga ma e ua matutua ai.

verses.en: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
verses.sm: Aua na fai atu Tavita, O le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu, ua avatua e ia le filemu i lona nuu, e mau foi i Ierusalema e faavavau.

verses.en: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
verses.sm: O sa Levi foi, latou te le toe tauave le malumalu, atoa ma mea uma e fai a“ ana sauniga.

verses.en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
verses.sm: Aua sa faitauina le fanauga a Levi e tusa ma upu mulimuli a Tavita, e afua i e ua luafulu o latou tausaga ma e ua matutua ai;

verses.en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.sm: aua o lo latou tofi lea e auauna i atalii o Arona i le galuega i Je fale o le ALII, i lotoā, ma potu, ma le faamamaina o mea paia uma, ma le faiga o le galuega i le fale o le Atua;

verses.en: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
verses.sm: ma le areto e laulauina i luma, ma le falaoa lelei mo le taulaga i mea e ‘ai, ma areto manifinifi e le faafefeteina, ma uamea salalafa, ma mea e palua, atoa ma fua faaofuofu uma, ma fua faaloloa;

verses.en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
verses.sm: e tutu foi i taeao uma e faafetai ma vivii atu i le ALII, e faapea foi i auau;

verses.en: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
verses.sm: e osi foi taulaga mu uma i le ALII i sapati, ma masina faatoa vaaia, ma tausamiga, e le aunoa i luma o le ALII, e pei ole faitau, e pei ona faatonuina ia te i latou;

verses.en: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: latou te anaana foi i le tausiga o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga, ma le tausiga o le malumalu, ma le tausiga o atalii o Arona o latou uso, i le galuega i le fale o le ALII. O le tofia o sa
